versions.subject: feat: add rules related to Barracuda ESG exploitation
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '/wget'
    CommandLine|re: 'https://[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}'
    CommandLine|contains: '--no-check-certificate'
    CommandLine|endswith: '.tar'
filter_local_ips:
    # Note: Uncomment this filter if you want to exclude local IPs
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'https://10.' #10.0.0.0/8
        - 'https://192.168.' #192.168.0.0/16
        - 'https://172.16.' #172.16.0.0/12
        - 'https://172.17.'
        - 'https://172.18.'
        - 'https://172.19.'
        - 'https://172.20.'
        - 'https://172.21.'
        - 'https://172.22.'
        - 'https://172.23.'
        - 'https://172.24.'
        - 'https://172.25.'
        - 'https://172.26.'
        - 'https://172.27.'
        - 'https://172.28.'
        - 'https://172.29.'
        - 'https://172.30.'
        - 'https://172.31.'
        - 'https://127.' #127.0.0.0/8
        - 'https://169.254.' #169.254.0.0/16
condition: selection
